topic: How can frequency planning address interference between satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems?
consensus_response: Frequency planning addresses interference by allocating non-overlapping bands, implementing exclusion zones, and using beamforming with ML to optimize signal directionality. Adaptive frequency hopping and time-division multiplexing further minimize interference, ensuring reliable communication services.
reference_context: Satellite communication systems operate on specific frequency bands, including S, L, Ku, and Ka bands, requiring careful planning to avoid interference.
